Adventurers' Guide:
You want to buy a Special Cocktail?
It costs 500,000 adena and grants you the same buff that I provide, but you can use it whenever you want.
In other words, you wouldn't have to return to me whenever you need a pick-me-up.
What's more, Special Cocktail has no minimum level requirements and can be sold to other characters.
So, what do you think?
